integrity: Two complete independent Python enumerators, explicit permutation generators and all-pairs shortest paths. No infinite-family extrapolation. No independent scholarly audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite statement only for the Nauru graph GP(12,5). Historical priority remains qualified because Watkins (1969) full text and the full graph-census dataset were not inspected. The base graph and the general edge-Kempe method are established prior work.
title: A Cayley sector and an irregular sector in Nauru edge-colouring reconfiguration
